# Checkmark Group

Displays a list of items with checkmark indicators, typically used to show completed items or feature lists.

## When to Use

- Feature comparison lists
- Completed task indicators
- Inclusion/exclusion lists
- Pricing plan features

## Jumpstart Implementation

| Jumpstart Component | Description |
|---------------------|-------------|
| `CheckMarkGroup` | List with checkmark indicators |

For code examples and API details, use the Jumpstart MCP tools:
- `get-jumpstart-components-apis` with `["CheckMarkGroup"]`
- `get-jumpstart-components-examples` with `["CheckMarkGroup"]`
